messages:
Aisha (CSM): Hey team — heads up on Novative usage trends. We're seeing 3x week-over-week token growth and a spike in 5xx errors for their embeddings route. They hit their soft quota this morning. Thinking we should do a proactive limit tweak + customer ping. Thoughts?
Tom (Customer Success): Thanks Aisha. Do we have exact numbers? Are the 5xx errors tied to rate limiting or runtime errors?
Riley (Support): Looking at the logs — most 5xx are downstream timeout from dedicated pool (502/504). Not rate-limits. I opened ticket #67821.
Marta (Product Ops): @Aisha please include current soft/hard quota thresholds and the proposed delta. We need to decide whether to bump soft only or hard.
Aisha (CSM): Current: soft 1M tokens/day, hard 2.5M. Yesterday they used 1.1M. Proposal: raise soft to 1.5M for 2 weeks while we investigate, keep hard the same. Plan to send them a friendly note explaining we're proactively adjusting soft limit + monitoring.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Re: errors — if it's timeouts we can temporarily route to their dedicated fallback region; will need ops to approve. ETA ~4h to change routing policy.
Tom (Customer Success): OK. For comms: short email + in-product banner. Draft below — feedback welcome.
Aisha (CSM): Email draft:

Subject: Quick update: temporary soft quota increase + monitoring

Hi Alex,

We've noticed Novative's recent spike in usage and some transient timeouts on embeddings. To avoid disruption we've increased your soft quota from 1M to 1.5M tokens/day for the next 14 days while our infra team investigates. No action required on your side.

We'll keep you posted and can roll back if needed. If you want a higher cap immediately, reply here and we'll fast-track it.

— Aisha (Customer Success)

Marta (Product Ops): Looks good. Suggest adding expected date/time window for monitoring and a link to the status page.
Aisha (CSM): Updated line: "We'll monitor through 2026-04-05 and share any findings; status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/67821"
Riley (Support): Ticket #67821 linked. Ops are running a health check now.
cs-notify-bot: Scheduled message queued: customer-notify/novative/soft-bump/1834568000
Ben (Solutions Eng): Ops routing change approved by oncall (permits temporary fallback). I'll apply after Aisha confirms send time.
Tom (Customer Success): Proposed send time: 2026-03-31 16:00 PT. A/B test subject lines? a) "We increased your soft quota to avoid disruption" b) "You're covered: temporary quota increase for Novative" — pick A for transactional clarity.
Aisha (CSM): Agree pick A. Also we'll add in-product banner from 16:05 PT for 48h.
Marta (Product Ops): Action items:
- Aisha: send email at 16:00 PT (assigned)
- Ben: apply routing fallback at 16:10 PT (assigned)
- Riley: follow ticket and post update by 16:30 PT (assigned)
- Marta: update internal ops runbook with thresholds (assigned)

Tom (Customer Success): Nice. @Aisha please CC Account Exec and legal if they ask. Also track whether they hit hard limit during bump.
Aisha (CSM): Will do. I'll post final send confirmation here.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Quick config snippet I'll run:

```
route_policy {
  customer_id: "novative"
  fallback_region: "us-west-2-dedicated"
  ttl: "14d"
}
```

I'll paste logs after change.
Riley (Support): Noted. Will monitor 5xx/latency dashboards and escalate if error rate >2%.
Aisha (CSM): Sent at 16:00 PT — copied below.
Aisha (CSM): (email body pasted) "We've increased your soft quota..."
cs-notify-bot: customer-email/novative/1834568005 delivery=sent
Tom (Customer Success): Great. Keep tracking. We'll reconvene next week if trend persists. :eyes:
Marta (Product Ops): Closing this thread once we confirm 48h banner and routing change logs.
Riley (Support): Update 16:28 PT: 5xx rate down to 0.6% after routing change.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks team — marking done for now.
